source_xy_policy: Keep x and y bounded at extent 3, with their coordinates, cell values, turn order, and empty-cell placement rule unchanged. At z extent 1, preserve the Source rows, columns, and two diagonals.
neighborhood: Straight three-cell lines in all 13 unoriented axis and diagonal directions: 27 rows, columns, and pillars; 18 diagonals within xy, xz, and yz planes; and 4 diagonals through all three axes. These are the 49 winning lines.
movement: On each turn, place the current player's X or O in any empty (x,y,z) cell. No gravity or supporting cell is required. Occupied or out-of-bounds placements remain illegal. Preserve restart and quit as host commands.
outcomes: After a placement, the current player wins if their mark occupies any of the 49 straight three-cell lines. Check for a win before a draw. If all 27 cells are occupied with no winning line, the result is a draw; otherwise play continues.
presentation: Show the board as one continuous cube volume with X and O at their 3D cell positions. Retain turn, win, and draw status; do not split the cube into layer panels.
input: A cell pick supplies its full (x,y,z) coordinate for placement. Use the engine's existing depth-layer selection, '[' and ']' keys, and on-screen buttons to address inner cells; retain the Source restart and quit bindings.
z_equals_one_tests: With z at extent 1, the game must equal the Source: X moves first, players alternate placing in empty cells of the 3×3 board, its rows, columns, and two diagonals win, and a full board without a line draws.

z_gt_one_tests.name: O wins on a yz diagonal
